LESSON PLAN MOVEMENT ACTIVITIES
 Week: Lesson:
 SCHOOL GRADE DATE TIME ROLL
 TWO
STRAND/THEME/TOPIC: GYMNASTICS
SUBSTRAND/SUB-THEME/SUB-TOPIC: Back to back balance
 By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to
  Name the parts of the body that are involved in back to back balance
  Perform back to back balance for strength
  Practise back to back balance for strength and creativity
  Appreciate back to back balance for strength and self-esteem
  Play games for enjoyment, creativity and peaceful co-existence
  Observe rules when performing back to back balance for own and others’
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
  Which parts of the body are involved in back to back balance?
  Which other body balances do you know?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Citizenship  Responsibility Citizenship
  Self-efficacy  Sharing Life skills
  Digital literacy  patience
  Learning to learn
  Creativity and imagination
  Communication and collaboration
  Critical thinking and problem solving
LEARNING RESOURCES
Field markers, cones
Mats, bean bags, white wash/lime
Foundation movement activities Teachers guide Grade 2 pg. 143-148
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs/groups
INTRODUCTION
Do a brainstorming activity with the learners
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Do a recap of the previous lesson.
 Step 2: Guide learners to understand the concept of Back to back balance
 Step 3: Demonstrate to learners Back to back balance for learners to observe first.
 Step 4: Learners to practice the concept in groups or pairs through the guidance of the teacher
 Step 4: Learners to observe safety measures as they practice
SUMMARY
Make summary notes/points
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Learners to ask and answer questions
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
 Learners to practice back to back balance at home.
